name: Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal S_n$, proper equivalence-query complexity is $n-1$, while log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the tagged-singleton class $\mathcal{Tag}_n$, log shattering is $\log_2(n+\lceil\log_2n\rceil+1)$, while proper equivalence-query complexity is $2$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity and Log Shattering of Singletons and Tagged Singletons.
